title: A cycle count of SVGA Value Wheat Flour 2Kg at Nairobi Distribution Centre finds a variance against the system balance
description: A scheduled cycle count of SVGA Value Wheat Flour 2Kg at Nairobi Distribution Centre recorded a physical count of 2150 units, against a system quantityOnHand of 2200.
businessContext: INV-POL-001 requires counters to record location, product, expected balance, counted balance and variance, with adjustments requiring independent review.

events.event: A cycle count is performed for SVGA Value Wheat Flour 2Kg at Nairobi Distribution Centre.
The system balance (quantityOnHand) is 2200; the physical count is 2150.
A variance of 50 units is recorded with the location, product and expected balance.
An independent reviewer, not the counter, assesses the variance before any adjustment is posted.

expectedOutcome: The variance of 50 units must not be silently corrected. INV-POL-001 requires the count evidence (location, product, expected and counted balance, variance) to be recorded, an independent review of the adjustment, and - since this may be a write-off for loss - approval at the level set by FIN-POL-002 in addition to the Inventory Manager's sign-off. No employee may erase the transaction to hide the discrepancy.
relevantFacts: SVGA Value Wheat Flour 2Kg (PRD-006) at Nairobi Distribution Centre has a system quantityOnHand of 2200 (inventory record INV-0006).
The physical cycle count recorded 2150 units, a variance of 50.

INV-POL-001: 'Counters record the location, product, expected balance, counted balance, variance and evidence. Adjustments require an independent review; write-offs for damage, expiry, loss or obsolescence require the Inventory Manager and the approval level in FIN-POL-002. No employee may erase a transaction to hide a discrepancy.'
requiredReasoning: Calculate the variance between the system balance and the physical count.
Identify the records required to document the count.
Identify who must independently review the adjustment before it is posted.
Determine whether an additional financial approval level applies to the resulting write-off.
